description: The page on upfork.dev where the user buys a paid product, or one of UpFork's plans while they're on. Nothing is bought here: give the user the link; they open it, sign in, and pay in USDT on TRON themselves. Says so instead when a product is free, already theirs, or comes with a plan. Give either product or plan.

plan.description: A plan's slug, while UpFork's paid plans are on (upfork.dev/pricing lists them then).

name: buy_link

outputSchema.description: Where to pay for a product or a plan: a page on upfork.dev. Paying happens there, by the user, in USDT on TRON.

for.description: What it's for: a product's title, or a plan's name and cycle.

note.description: What the user should know: whether it needs buying at all, signing in, and how paying works.

price.description: Its price, as the site shows it.

url.description: The page to open: the checkout, or the product's page when there's nothing to buy.
